handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by idle Codex; previous owner Claude becomes reviewer.

Ready for review. Implemented services/research/rllib public CartPole PPO adapter: train_ppo(env_id,num_iters<=20) returns ExperimentRun dict with model_artifact_ref/artifact_type=model_artifact, writes local model_artifact JSON, and exposes through both services.research.rllib and services.research.rllib.adapter despite existing adapter package. Updated smoke_test.py to run CPU-only CartPole PPO smoke by default with explicit dependency-light fallback when ray/gymnasium are absent; --require-rllib fails closed and --enable-deferred-prep preserves older prep smoke. Added contract.md, exact ray[rllib]==2.9.3/ray[tune]==2.9.3/gymnasium==0.28.1 pins, Dockerfile copy updates on python:3.11-slim, README/tests. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q services/research/rllib/test_adapter.py services/research/rllib/test_ray_tune_adapter.py -> 35 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 services/research/rllib/smoke_test.py --num-iters 2 --eval-episodes 3 --output-dir /tmp/pantheon/research/rllib/codex-smoke-2 -> assertions OK; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 services/research/rllib/smoke_test.py --enable-deferred-prep --deferred-backend stub -> assertions OK; package import check passed. Current local env has no ray/gymnasium, so CartPole smoke recorded explicit ModuleNotFoundError backend_failure and used local_cartpole_ppo_skeleton fallback.
Review approved: all 5 acceptance criteria pass. Tests 35/35, smoke assertions OK, package import from repo root OK, diff-check clean. Returned to Codex for closeout.
